title: Analyze pasted report with the matching rubric
description: This verifies that a visitor can paste report text, choose the correct document type, and receive a completed analysis with weighted scoring and criterion-level feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste report text into the document field
Select a document type
Run the analysis
Verify an overall weighted score is displayed
Verify criterion-level feedback and recommendations are displayed

title: Analyze pasted document and review weighted results
description: This verifies that a user can paste a report, choose the matching document type and rubric template, run analysis, and review the overall score with criterion feedback, evidence, and recommendations.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a report with clear section structure into the document field
Select the matching document type
Select the default rubric template
Click the analyze button
Verify the analysis result is displayed
Verify the overall score, criterion feedback, evidence, and recommendations are displayed

title: Analyze an uploaded PDF and review extracted text before scoring
description: This verifies that a user can upload a PDF, review the extracted readable text, and successfully analyze it after confirming the document content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a PDF with readable text content
Wait for extraction progress to complete
Verify the extracted text is displayed
Select the matching document type
Select the default rubric template
Click the analyze button
Verify the weighted analysis result is displayed

title: Review extracted PDF text before analysis
description: This verifies that a visitor can upload a PDF, observe extraction progress, and review the extracted readable text before continuing.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a PDF document
Verify PDF extraction progress is displayed
Verify extracted readable text is displayed

title: Keep advanced rubric changes with the current tab draft
description: This verifies that rubric edits are stored automatically with a non-empty document draft in the current browser tab and restored after a reload.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Enter a document draft
Open advanced rubric controls
Edit a criterion title
Edit a criterion weight
Mark the criterion as not applicable
Wait for the current-tab draft to save automatically
Reload the page in the same browser tab
Verify the document and rubric changes are restored
Verify the criterion is marked as not applicable

title: Edit rubric criteria and rerun analysis with updated scoring
description: This verifies that a user can open advanced rubric controls, modify criteria and weights, validate the rubric, and rerun analysis so the updated weighted score replaces the prior result.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a report with enough content for scoring into the document field
Select the matching document type
Open the advanced rubric controls
Adjust a criterion weight
Add a new criterion
Remove an existing criterion
Click the analyze button
Verify the updated analysis result is displayed
Verify the new weighted score replaces the previous result

title: See the rubric update when the document type changes
description: This verifies that switching document types updates the default rubric and document-specific guidance for the selected template.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a document type
Verify the rubric changes to match the selected template
Verify document-specific guidance is displayed

title: Switch to a different document type and confirm the rubric updates
description: This verifies that changing from one supported document type to another replaces the rubric with the appropriate template.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select one document type
Select a different document type
Verify the rubric updates to the new template
Verify the rubric now matches the chosen document type

title: Mark a rubric criterion not applicable and analyze successfully
description: This verifies that a user can mark a rubric criterion as not applicable and still complete analysis with the adjusted rubric.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a report with enough content for scoring into the document field
Select the matching document type
Open the advanced rubric controls
Mark one criterion as not applicable
Click the analyze button
Verify the analysis completes successfully
Verify criterion-level feedback reflects the not applicable adjustment

title: Add and remove rubric criteria
description: This verifies that a user can expand the rubric by adding a criterion and then remove an unneeded criterion before analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open advanced rubric controls
Add a criterion
Remove a criterion
Verify the updated rubric is displayed
Verify the criterion list reflects the add and remove changes

title: Review extracted text from a PDF with appendix handling
description: This verifies that a visitor can review extracted PDF text, detect appendix content, and choose whether to exclude the appendix before analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a PDF document
Verify extracted text is displayed for review
Verify appendix-related controls or warnings are displayed

title: Handle appendix exclusion before analysis
description: This verifies that when an appendix is detected, a user can choose to exclude it and continue with the adjusted document before analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a document that includes an appendix heading and appendix content
Verify an appendix detection prompt is displayed
Confirm the appendix exclusion choice
Select the matching document type
Click the analyze button
Verify the analysis result is displayed for the adjusted document

title: Replace the current document
description: This verifies that a visitor can remove an existing document and start over with a new one from the analyzer.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste report text into the document field
Remove the current document
Verify the document input is cleared
Verify no analysis result is displayed

title: Clear a drafted analysis and return to a blank state
description: This verifies that a user can reset the current document and analysis so they can start a fresh evaluation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a short report into the document input
Click the control to clear the current draft
Confirm the reset when prompted
Verify the empty initial state is displayed
Verify the prior analysis state is cleared

title: Keep appendix text in the document and analyze
description: This verifies that a user can decline appendix exclusion and continue editing the full document before analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a document that includes an appendix heading and appendix content
Verify an appendix detection prompt is displayed
Cancel the appendix exclusion decision
Verify the document remains available for editing
Select the matching document type
Click the analyze button
Verify the analysis result is displayed

title: Start over after editing a pasted report
description: This verifies that a user can abandon an in-progress pasted report and return to a blank analyzer state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Paste a short report into the document input
Click the control to clear or start over
Confirm the reset when prompted
Verify the document input is empty
Verify the analyzer shows the initial empty state

title: Validate rubric errors and continue editing
description: This verifies that invalid rubric input shows validation feedback and that correcting the rubric clears the issue so editing can continue.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open advanced rubric controls
Enter an invalid weight
Leave a criterion empty
Verify validation feedback is displayed
Correct the rubric input
Verify the rubric can continue being edited

title: Fix missing input validation and complete analysis
description: This verifies that a user sees validation guidance when the document or rubric is incomplete, corrects the issue, and then completes analysis successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the analyze button
Verify validation messages are displayed
Paste a report with clear content into the document field
Select the matching document type
Click the analyze button
Verify the analysis result is displayed

title: Review extraction quality for a multi-column PDF before analysis
description: This verifies that a user can inspect extracted text from a multi-column PDF and confirm the text is usable before running analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a multi-column PDF with readable text content
Wait for extraction progress to complete
Verify the extracted text is displayed
Verify the user can review the extracted text before analysis

title: Review legal information and return to the analyzer
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the privacy and terms pages from the app and return to the analyzer without needing an account.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the privacy page from the footer
Verify privacy policy content is displayed
Open the terms page from the footer
Verify terms content is displayed

title: Read the privacy policy from the dedicated page
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the privacy page and read the storage and data-processing disclosures without signing in.

steps.description: Navigate to /privacy
Verify the privacy policy content is displayed
Verify browser storage and data-processing disclosures are visible

title: Read privacy disclosures from the footer and return to the analyzer
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the privacy policy from the footer, review data-processing disclosures, and return to the analyzer.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to open the privacy policy from the footer
Verify privacy and storage disclosures are displayed
Click the link to return to the analyzer
Verify the document analyzer is displayed

title: Read the terms of service from the dedicated page
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the terms page and review the service terms without signing in.

steps.description: Navigate to /terms
Verify the terms of service content is displayed
Verify the service terms disclosures are visible

title: Review terms disclosures before using the analyzer
description: This verifies that a visitor can start on the terms page, review the terms, and navigate back to the analyzer without authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /terms
Verify the terms content is displayed
Return to the document analyzer from the terms page
Verify the document analyzer is displayed

title: Review privacy disclosures before using the analyzer
description: This verifies that a visitor can start on the privacy page, review the disclosures, and navigate back to the analyzer without authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /privacy
Verify the browser storage disclosure is displayed
Return to the document analyzer from the privacy page
Verify the document analyzer is displayed

title: Move from the analyzer to the privacy policy and back
description: This verifies that a visitor can open privacy information from the analyzer footer and return to the document analyzer afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the privacy page from the footer
Verify the privacy policy page is displayed
Return to the document analyzer from the legal page
Verify the document analyzer is displayed

title: Move from the analyzer to the terms page and back
description: This verifies that a visitor can open terms information from the analyzer footer and return to the document analyzer afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the terms page from the footer
Verify the terms of service page is displayed
Return to the document analyzer from the legal page
Verify the document analyzer is displayed
